subject: BBWAA Relief Pitcher of the Year Award
query: what is the relief pitcher of the year award
title: What is the Relief Pitcher of the Year award? New MLB honor, first winners Nov. 11
answer: The Relief Pitcher of the Year is a new award from the Baseball Writers' Association of America for the best reliever in each league. 2026 is its first season. Winners are announced on MLB Network on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, in the 7-8 p.m. ET show together with the Cy Young Awards.
body:
The BBWAA announced on Aug. 23, 2025, that it had voted to create the award in each league. It is the writers' fifth annual award after MVP, Cy Young, Rookie of the Year and Manager of the Year, and their first new one since Manager of the Year in 1983. Jayson Stark, who chaired the committee that proposed it, said "relief pitching now dominates this sport."

The 2026 finalists are Bryan Baker (Rays), Cade Smith (Guardians) and Louis Varland (Blue Jays) in the American League, and Jhoan Duran (Phillies), Trevor Megill (Brewers) and Mason Miller (Padres) in the National League.

It is not the same as the Mariano Rivera and Trevor Hoffman Reliever of the Year Awards, which MLB has given since 2014 and which are voted on by retired relievers; those are presented later the same night at the MLB Awards show. Earlier reliever honors included the formula-based Rolaids Relief Man Award and MLB's Delivery Man of the Year (2005-2013).
in_the_news: The first BBWAA Relief Pitcher of the Year winners will be announced on Nov. 11, 2026.
